title: Analyst - Data Science & Spatial Analytics
jobDescription:
Location: Delhi / Gurgaon / Bangalore Business Unit: Foundations Advisory About Sattva Since 2009, Sattva has been working with foundations, philanthropists, companies, non-profits, multi-laterals and impact ecosystems across India, Africa, and Asia, on a collective mission to develop scalable impact solutions for a sustainable world. Sattva is driven by impact and powered by knowledge, always striving to bring the right balance of head-heart-hands to its work. We at Sattva believe that age-old problems need new-age thinking and rigorous implementation, with empathy at the core. And, that’s what we deliver through our end-to-end support capabilities covering research, strategy consulting, programme management, impact assessment and more, to maximize social return on every investment. About the Team Foundations team collaborates with a network of global foundations, alongside multilateral aid agencies, aiming to inform, influence, and profoundly impact social and environmental outcomes resulting from their investments in diverse sectors such as education, child development, gender, health, and more. Our primary focus is on catalyzing ecosystem transformation by rigorously solving problems, formulating strategic solutions which are logically sound, effective on the ground and ensuring all stakeholders are effectively engaged while their interests are covered. The Opportunity As an Analyst, you will contribute to a project that analyses large-scale and spatial datasets to inform government stakeholders. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of data science, policy research, and geospatial analytics, applying analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex challenges. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to generate insights that strengthen evidence-based decision-making and create lasting impact within the social development ecosystem. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Data Management & Cleaning : Assist in cleaning, organising, and managing large datasets (survey, administrative, or satellite data) with a strong emphasis on accuracy and consistency. Geospatial & Remote Sensing Analysis: Support spatial data analysis using GIS tools such as QGIS, Arc GIS, or Google Earth Engine, including basic raster processing and mapping tasks. Programming & Data Processing: Write and maintain well-documented code in Python, R, or SQL for tasks such as data transformation, analysis, and automation of workflows. Collaborative Research Support: Work closely with senior researchers and fellow interns to contribute to policy-relevant research projects, including background research and data analysis. Key qualifications and experiences Master’s, M.Phil., or Ph.D. in disciplines: Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Geography, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Environmental Studies, or Related Quantitative Fields Proficiency in Python / R / SQL / GIS tools (QGIS, Arc GIS, or GEE) along with any data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Plotly, etc.) is a must Any previous exposure to spatial econometrics/ machine learning/geospatial analytics/remote sensing will be advantageous Previous internship experience in working with large datasets(surveys, admin data, or satellite/remote sensing) is preferred Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas effectively Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving skills Display strong interpersonal skills, humility, willingness to listen and excitement to learn at all times Self-driven, curious and adaptable personality with the ability to produce accountable work We cultivate a supportive and inclusive work environment for all our employees and reinforce diversity in our workplace. All applications regardless of race, religion, caste, color, place of origin, gender, sexuality, disability and age will be welcome and will be fairly evaluated as per the requirements of the role. Please note: The organization follows a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy, under which employees are required to use their personal laptops for work purposes, subject to compliance with the company’s information security and IT policies. Necessary tools for operating, like MS office etc, will be provided. title: Associate Consultant - Government Consulting
jobDescription:
Location: Mumbai Business Unit: Foundations Advisory Language preference: Marathi speaking preferred About Sattva We Partner to deliver social impact at scale Sattva Consulting is an Indian-origin, Global impact consulting firm and since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, businesses and government to deliver societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our research & advisory services, knowledge platforms and collaborative initiatives. Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in About the Team Foundations team collaborates with a network of global philanthropic foundations, alongside multilateral aid agencies, aiming to inform, influence, and profoundly impact social and environmental outcomes resulting from their investments in diverse sectors such as education, child development, gender, health, and more. Our primary focus is on catalysing ecosystem transformation by rigorously solving problems, formulating strategic solutions which are logically sound, effective on the ground and ensuring all stakeholders are effectively engaged while their interests are covered. The Opportunity As an Associate Consultant in the Foundations team, you will be an integral part of a team that designs and builds solutions that best address our clients’ needs and create measurable impact. As an Associate Consultant, you will get an opportunity to work alongside individuals/teams on research, problem solving, stakeholder engagement, program strategy and/or implementation. Key Responsibilities Presentation: -- Present readings/research findings into insights using a visually compelling manner. -- Adhere to standards of strategic communication (pyramid principle, objective communication, brevity, simplicity). -- Develop templates and document key project artefacts, notes, decks, and databases to ensure the efficient delivery of client-facing deliverables. Data Analysis: -- Understand the objectives of analytics, the project context, and identify relevant data for achieving objectives. -- Conduct relevant quantitative/qualitative analysis on the data to cull out meaningful insights relevant to client problem. -- Present data insights in a concise and meaningful manner using relevant visualisations. Research: -- Possess a broad understanding of different types of research, research methodologies, and research frameworks. -- Lead primary and secondary research (proficiency in literature review, market research, solution landscape mapping, policy research, etc.) -- Prepare interview questions for primary research, manage focus groups, carry out interviews and conduct surveys. -- Cull out insights from research findings. Project Management: -- Possess an understanding of project management frameworks. -- Contribute towards project planning and work closely with the project lead in maintaining governance routine to track progress of the project. -- Actively track project timelines and independently own multiple small deliverables or parts of larger deliverable. -- Strive to create a collaborative climate with teams, partners, and clients. -- Identify, articulate, and report risks effectively and on time. Problem Solving -- Possess basic knowledge of problem-solving frameworks (such as issue trees) and use them to solve simple problems or parts of a complex problem. -- Bring rigour and curiosity, following due process to solve simple problems or parts of a complex problem. -- Conduct primary and secondary research to arrive at the insights needed to solve the problem. -- Distinguishes between relevant and irrelevant pieces of information while presenting the problem, approach and solution to key stakeholders. Stakeholder Engagement -- Practise active listening in internal as well as external discussions. -- Ensure proactive and regular communication with relevant stakeholders. -- Build credibility with relevant stakeholders through effective and on time delivery. -- Assist in preparing for and coordinating meetings, workshops, and convenings with key government stakeholders. Key qualifications and experiences -- 2-4 years of experience in consulting, research, project management, stakeholder management in corporate, social enterprises, consulting firms or global foundations. -- Undergraduate or postgraduate degree in political science, development studies, sociology, economics, or equivalent. -- Prior experience in the social impact / development sector—including research, policy implementation, or fieldwork with government stakeholders or NGOs will be preferred. -- Prior experience in a client or customer facing role will be an added advantage. -- Display humility, willingness to listen and excitement to learn. -- Willingness to work from client location, 5 days a week, if required / travel to remote locations as per the requirements of the project. Why Sattva? It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business. -- Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design -- Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment -- Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can -- Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow How to Prepare? This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva. FAQs on the Hiring Process Next Steps Together towards a sustainable world with opportunity for all! Sattva is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, caste, creed, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected and/or marginalized characteristics. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing all employees with education, training, and development opportunities to create a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and included. Please note: The organization follows a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy, under which employees are required to use their personal laptops for work purposes, subject to compliance with the company’s information security and IT policies. You will work alongside diverse teams across MEL, program strategy, delivery,, and business development, shaping solutions that create measurable, lasting impact for the foundations we partner with. Key Responsibilities Project Management -- Independently build project plans for MEL engagements while contributing to broader program design and implementation roadmaps. -- Actively track project milestones, manage multiple workstreams, and coordinate across program teams to ensure execution as per timelines. -- Demonstrate strong time management and prioritisation skills, focusing effort on activities directly linked to program outcomes and impact. -- Proactively identify and surface project and program-level risks, working with the project lead to design mitigation approaches. -- Maintain comprehensive documentation of MEL frameworks, program knowledge assets, and learnings, ensuring critical information is well-documented and easily accessible. Problem solving & Study design -- Frame complex development problems accurately and translate them into clear, actionable lines of enquiry for the team and client. -- Design MEL frameworks, theories of change, and results frameworks aligned to client outcomes, while contributing to the underlying program design where relevant. -- Develop research and evaluation designs, finalise data collection tools, and define indicators across outcome and output levels, drawing on established sectoral frameworks. -- Structure and lead analysis, synthesise information into clear insights, and form and test hypotheses that inform both measurement and program strategy. -- Conduct rigorous secondary and primary research, developing insights and recommendations that strengthen assessments, program design choices, and course-correction decisions. -- Translate data into informative insights and actionable recommendations, communicating these effectively to internal teams and external clients. -- Go beyond the MEL brief where useful, identify program design gaps, strategic questions, or implementation risks surfaced through measurement work and recommend as well as deliver relevant solutions.. Team Collaboration -- Lead a team of 2–3 Associates/Analysts to deliver high-quality project outputs on time, across MEL, research, strategy and delivery workstreams. -- Collaborate with senior stakeholders within Sattva, contributing innovative ideas, frameworks, and approaches to support business growth and practice-building. -- Give and receive constructive feedback respectfully, and coach junior team members on both technical MEL skills and broader consulting craft. Manage conflicts within the team openly and respectfully. Strategic Thinking & Sector knowledge -- Stay abreast of new trends in MEL practice as well as the broader sector or ecosystem the program operates in (e.g. education, health, livelihoods, climate). -- Gather diverse perspectives, frameworks, and mental models across measurement, program strategy, and systems thinking, to sharpen design and solutioning. Key qualifications and experiences: -- 5–6 years of experience across consulting, social sector program management, research, or philanthropic advisory, with meaningful exposure to both measurement and program delivery. -- Minimum 4 years of hands-on MEL experience in the social impact sector is essential, with a strong technical foundation in theories of change, results frameworks, indicator design, mixed-methods research, and data analytics. -- An MBA or postgraduate degree in economics, development studies, public policy, social sciences, data sciences, etc., from a reputed institution is preferred. -- Demonstrated ability to go beyond measurement — shaping program strategy, informing design choices, and translating evidence into decisions funders and implementers can act on. -- On-ground implementation and field work experience is essential — directly managing delivery, conducting field-based data collection and stakeholder consultations, tracking progress against milestones, and reporting outcomes to funders, boards, or government stakeholders. -- Prior experience working with or within foundations, CSR teams, or large funders, and familiarity with one or more priority sectors (e.g. education, livelihoods, health, climate, gender), is an added advantage. -- Comfort and willingness to travel to remote locations for field work, often in challenging conditions. -- Experience leading small teams of 2–3 members is essential. -- Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage credibly with middle and senior management at client organisations. -- Humility, a genuine willingness to listen and learn, and comfort operating in ambiguity. Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Self-driven, curious and adaptable personality with the ability to work independently. - Mandatory About Sattva We Partner to deliver social impact at scale Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships. Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and the UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in . The Opportunity Sattva partners with governments and philanthropic organizations to strengthen public systems through flagship initiatives. Working closely with senior government stakeholders, the team designs and delivers high-impact advisory engagements that strengthen administrative systems, improve institutional effectiveness, and enable sustainable implementation. As a Lead in the Government Advisory Practice, you will play a key role in delivering complex government advisory engagements, managing senior stakeholder relationships, and identifying opportunities to deepen Sattva's engagement with government partners. jobDescription:

- About Sattva We are an organization driven by the mission to end poverty in our lifetime. Our work focuses on scalable solutions for sustainable social impact. We work with our clients
- corporations, philanthropists, foundations, and social organizations

This approach helps us, and our clients develop holistic solutions for solving critical societal problems. We are driven by impact and powered by knowledge. We bring the right balance of the head-heart-hand to our work. Our work is powered by the passionate energy of our mission-driven young team, guided by the strong leadership and advisory board with multi-dimensional experience in business and social sectors. Our team of 400 (and growing rapidly) across offices in Bangalore, Mumbai, and Delhi comes with stellar professional credentials from diverse backgrounds and is bound together by our common commitment to social impact. The opportunity The Analyst will be an integral part of a team that works on designing and building solutions that address our CSR customer needs and create measurable social impact. In this role, you will be a part of the team that works with the corporate sector in India building our work in social impact consulting. You will get to be a part of our business development conversations in the ecosystem and also get to work on select projects by working hand in hand with the team in problem-solving, working with multiple stakeholders, and building rapport with the middle and senior management of our CSR clients. The exposure and work will cut across all thematic areas that corporates work on. In addition, the following will be the key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Mapping the CSR landscape in India and spotting potential opportunities for social impact. Understanding a potential client’s requirements for social impact and being able to translate that into proposals showcasing structured thinking. Solving simple problems or parts of complex problems by having an understanding of basic problem-solving framework Conducting research as required to arrive at the insights needed to solve the problem or to spot potential opportunities for social impact. Engage with stakeholders proactively with effective communication and build on the engagement to build a long term sustainable relationship. Supporting the team in ideating on growth in the sector. Go beyond own deliverables to support others in the team including the marketing team or the larger organization where required Work smoothly with peers and managers and is able to receive constructive feedback well Contribute to the creation of proposals Deliver high-quality documents consistently and work with the team to ensure timely delivery of project deliverables Support in the documentation of learnings and potentially the creation of reusable knowledge from the project Key qualifications and experiences At Sattva, our goal is to realize the impact on the ground and drive a collective win by engaging with multiple stakeholders. We are looking for individuals who align with our mission of alleviating poverty in our lifetime. All applications regardless of race, religion, caste, colour, place of origin, gender, sexuality, disability and age will be welcome and will be fairly evaluated as per the requirements of the role. title: Associate Consultant - Growth Strategy and Sales Operations
jobDescription:
Location: Delhi NCR About Sattva We Partner to deliver social impact at scale Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships. Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and the UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in . The Opportunity Sattva is looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented and execution-focused Associate Consultant to support the leadership and senior management team in driving business growth across North India. This role sits at the intersection of growth strategy, business development, pre-sales, and sales operations. Working closely with senior managers and leadership, the Associate Consultant will support the execution of Sattva’s go-to-market (GTM) strategy by building market intelligence, developing high-quality client-facing collateral, and maintaining sales governance processes for effective client engagement. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast paced environment, curating structured and well-researched collateral, coordinating across multiple stakeholders, and is looking to build a strong foundation in consulting, sales strategy and business development within the impact ecosystem. Key Responsibilities
1. Go-to-Market Strategy & Planning Support the execution of Sattva’s North India GTM strategy across multiple sectors and business units. Support the classification of strategic accounts across different engagement stages and assist in capturing and regularly updating such data. Regularly update account intelligence by analysing business priorities, CSR and ESG strategies, sustainability commitments, leadership priorities, partnerships and whitespace opportunities, with guidance from senior management. Assist in planning and execution of strategic client engagement initiatives including executive meetings, industry events, roundtables, networking forums and leadership outreach. Assist in developing Talking Points and Pitch Decks for leadership prior to meetings.
2. Market Research & Strategic Intelligence Conduct high-quality secondary research across industries, companies, CSR, ESG, sustainability, philanthropy and emerging market trends. Support senior management in preparing for strategic client meetings through research, opportunity assessments, meeting briefs and executive summaries. Develop high-quality client-facing collateral including proposals, presentations, concept notes, capability decks, briefing notes, budget analyses and case studies under the guidance of senior team members. Support the development of sector-specific insights that strengthen client conversations and market positioning. Contribute to maintaining repositories of market intelligence, templates and reusable knowledge assets.
3. Sales Operations, Governance & CRM Management Support governance of the North India business development pipeline through maintaining structured trackers and dashboards. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to support timely completion of GTM activities, deliverables and follow-ups in maintaining Salesforce data by ensuring accurate and timely updates of historic and ongoing account information, client interactions, opportunity stages, meeting notes, proposals and follow-up actions Support account owners by maintaining accurate pipeline information and ensuring sales data remains complete and up to date Support weekly pipeline reviews by tracking action items, following up on pending activities and helping maintain governance processes, templates and operating mechanisms across the sales lifecycle.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration Collaborate with peers, senior managers and cross-functional teams to support research, account intelligence, proposal development, and sales enablement activities. Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Business Units to gather inputs and ensure timely completion of deliverables. Contribute to creating high-quality presentations and data analysis by working closely with delivery teams, domain experts and leadership. The Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate will have: A graduate degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Communications or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is desirable but not mandatory. 2-4 years of experience in consulting, research, business development, pre-sales, sales operations or a similar analytical role. Strong analytical and research capabilities (including through use of AI) with the ability to synthesise information into structured insights. Proficiency in Microsoft Power Point, Excel and Word. Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce is desirable; willingness to learn is essential. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and collaborative environment, with strong coordination skills. High attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work. Strong written and verbal communication skills are desirable. Interest in CSR, ESG, sustainability, philanthropy or impact consulting will be an added advantage. Why Join Sattva? At Sattva, you'll work directly with senior leaders on some of the firm's most strategic growth priorities. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how one of India's leading impact consulting firms builds markets, develops client relationships and scales its advisory services. You will gain exposure to leadership decision-making, consulting across sectors, strategic account management, GTM strategy, sales operations and business development, making this an exceptional platform for accelerated professional growth. Together towards a sustainable world with opportunity for all! Sattva is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, caste, creed, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected and/or marginalized characteristics. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. title: Analyst - India Partner Network (IPN)
jobDescription:
Location: Bangalore Tenure: contract (Convert basis performance) About Sattva We Partner to deliver social impact at scale Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory & orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships. Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in About India Partner Network India Partner Network (IPN) ( www.indiapartnernetwork.org ) is a tech-enabled platform incubated by Sattva Consulting to make institutional capacity building more accessible to small and mid-sized NGOs in India. Since its launch in August 2023, IPN has grown into an ecosystem of 4,000+ NGOs, 6,000+ users, and a growing network of partners and service providers . IPN supports NGOs through knowledge resources, capacity building events, assessments, service provider discovery, and ecosystem connections. IPN is now entering its next phase of growth as it transitions into an independent Section 8 entity, Ready Next IPN Foundation . This role offers an early-stage opportunity to master digital platform operations while rapidly evolving into a well-rounded product professional. The Opportunity We are looking for a high-ownership, problem solving Analyst to build the operational backbone of IPN platform products. If you have a basic background or deep curiosity in building digital products, this role is your playground. This role sits at the intersection of execution excellence and product building. You will start by supporting first and later managing workflows and delivery across IPN products
- Events, Directory, Knowledge Resources and additionally, Program support and stakeholder data. Over time, you will look at these operations through a product lens
- identifying user friction, utilising low-code/no-code tools to automate processes, and translating ground realities into platform feature requirements. It is a unique trajectory designed to transition a sharp operational thinker into a data-driven product champion. What you will own Events & Campaign Operations --Manage end-to-end event operations, including setup, multi-team coordination, and flawless execution. --Support outreach activities across multiple channels (whatsapp, email etc.) to drive user participation and network engagement. --Coordinate logistics seamlessly with internal teams and external ecosystem stakeholders. --Manage participant data collection, registration trackers, post-event learning insights. --Support post-event retention through follow-up communications, resource sharing, and feedback loops. Knowledge Curation & Management --Curate highly relevant sector resources, toolkits, knowledge materials for the platform. --Support translation and localization efforts to improve product accessibility for regional grassroots NGOs. --Develop derivative knowledge products (e.g., quick-learn videos, visual guides, and infographics etc). --Create resource packages and engagement messages (Whats App/social media) to drive platform content adoption. Directory Management & Partner Engagement --Support the growth and onboarding of the IPN Service Directory ecosystem. --Manage partner profile collection, necessary due diligence and execute platform listing. --Support building of directory partnerships and marketing initiatives to boost discovery.
4. Program Management & Product Enhancements --Maintain internal program trackers, documentation, and progress metrics to ensure execution efficiency. --Coordinate partner communications, including platform updates and engagement emails. --Support data collection, primary and secondary research, quantitative analysis, and drafting for donor and partner progress reports and decks. --Identify operational bottlenecks and contribute to streamlining processes, while driving continuous feedback loops to align transactions with user expectations and consumption patterns, thus informing actionable product iterations. What success will look like In the first 3-6 months --Flawless execution and end-to-end ownership of IPN Events and communications. --Streamlined workflow for Directory partners with clean, completed profile data. --A growing bank of curated, diverse format Knowledge content hosted on the platform. --A strong foundation of research and stakeholder understanding, allowing you to support stronger Partner communications and Program design and delivery. In 12 months --You have automated repetitive operational tasks (like event communications or data compilation or user research etc.) using lean processes and low/no-code tools. --You are utilising platform data and user/partner feedback to suggest structural changes to the directory onboarding funnel, event delivery and knowledge adoption formats. Future Growth Potential --This role is designed to be a product launchpad. As you gain platform product operations and deep dive into Programs and data, you will transition from executing the workflows and managing delivery to influencing the product design and strategy. --Over 18–24 months, a high-performing analyst will have the opportunity to transition into a Product Operations Consultant , serving as the bridge between user/stakeholder realities and product development. Who we are looking for Must-Haves -- 6 months to 1yr of experience in program coordination, project management, or operations (experience/ background in understanding digital products is a strong plus). --A proactive learner who is highly adaptable and can quickly build fluency in IPN’s platform features, processes and metrics. --Comfortable with data tracking, basic analysis, and maintaining spreadsheets and dashboards. --Strong written and verbal communication skills to coordinate with internal teams and external NGO leaders. --Strong organization skills, execution discipline, and an absolute attention to detail. --Ability to work in ambiguity within a lean team where priorities evolve quickly. Good-to-Haves --Familiarity with AI tools, data tools and low-code/no-code or automation tools (e.g., Gemini, Chat GPT, Caude, Clickup, Zapier, Make, n8n, Coda, Mailchimp, Snowflake etc.). --Ability to read, write, or work in Hindi or other Indian regional languages to drive vernacular outreach. --Prior experience working within the nonprofit ecosystem, B2B platforms, or social impact tech models You will work closely with the IPN leadership team and collaborate with product, partnerships, events and external consultants. You will report to IPN Platform and Ecosystem Engagement Lead. Why Sattva? It's not about us really

title: Consultant - Growth Communications
jobDescription:
Location: Bangalore
- In-person (preferred) / Hybrid Engagement Type: Contract Reports t o: IPN CEO / Platform and Ecosystem Engagement Lead About Sattva We Partner to deliver social impact at scale Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory & orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships. Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in About India Partner Network India Partner Network (IPN) is a tech-enabled platform incubated by Sattva Consulting to make institutional capacity building more accessible to small and mid-sized NGOs in India. Since its launch in August 2023, IPN has grown into an ecosystem of 4,000+ NGOs, 6,000+ users, and a growing network of partners and service providers. IPN supports NGOs through knowledge resources, capacity building events, assessments, service provider discovery, and ecosystem connections. IPN is now entering its next phase of growth as it transitions into an independent Section 8 entity, Ready Next IPN Foundation. This is a unique opportunity to join early and help shape the voice, positioning, and platform growth in India’s nonprofit ecosystem. The Opportunity Over the last two and a half years, the platform has grown from an early platform idea into a national digital first ecosystem reaching thousands of NGOs users and over a hundred service provider partners across India. Our next challenge is to build IPN into a trusted, recognisable, high-engagement brand that small and mid-sized NGOs actively use to become institutionally stronger. That is where this role comes in. We are looking for a Growth Communications Lead (Consultant) who can help turn IPN’s platform, products, insights, and ecosystem work into a strong market-facing narrative, and brand and communications strategy. title: Associate Consultant - Innovation Practice
jobDescription:
Location: Bengaluru About Sattva We Partner to deliver social impact at scale We are an organization driven by the mission to end poverty in our lifetime. Our work focuses on scalable solutions for sustainable social impact. We work with our clients
- corporations, philanthropists, foundations, and social organizations
- to achieve social impact goals effectively and maximize the social return on their investment. Deep understanding across sectors and collaboration with multiple stakeholders drive our work. This approach helps us, and our clients develop holistic solutions for solving critical societal problems. We are driven by impact and powered by knowledge. We bring the right balance of the head-heart-hand to our work. Our work is powered by the passionate energy of our mission-driven young team, guided by the strong leadership and advisory board with multi-dimensional experience in business and social sectors. Our team of 400 (and growing rapidly) across offices in Bangalore, Mumbai, and Delhi comes with stellar professional credentials from diverse backgrounds and is bound together by our common commitment to social impact. About the Team Sattva’s Innovation Practice is India’s dedicated intermediary for the TRL 4–7 gap, sitting at the intersection of philanthropic capital mobilisation, impact intelligence, and AI-enabled advisory. Underlying everything the Innovation Practice does is a simple conviction: scientific discovery only fulfils its potential when it reaches the people who need it. India produces world-class science. The gap is not in research, it is in the journey from research to real-world application. Two capabilities are needed to bridge that gap, which we are building as a part of Innovation Practice at Sattva: Translational Research Infrastructure – We are increasing our focus on enabling scientists and innovators to prototype, test, and pilot academic research to move faster by enabling this infrastructure. Science Communication
- We are also building our capacity in science communication
- translating complex technology initiatives into stories that a funder, policymaker, or citizen can understand and act on. The Opportunity As an Associate Consultant in the Innovations team, you will be an integral part of a team that designs and builds solutions that best address our clients’ needs and create measurable impact. As an Associate Consultant, you will get an opportunity to work alongside individuals/teams on research, problem solving, stakeholder engagement, program strategy and/or implementation. This is an early stage role in an emerging practice, where you will be one of the founding team members of a practice that is being built from scratch. Key Responsibilities ● Business Development & Funder Management: ○ Assist the team in managing a portfolio of active funder conversations across domestic foundations, international philanthropies, and CSR from proposal and close. ○ Assist in preparation of client proposals and advisory decks. ○ Support in anchoring the roundtable series, the flagship events and other marketing channels. ○ Manage follow-through on funders contact ensuring no relationship falls through the cracks. ● Client Delivery: ○ Assist in delivery of innovation engagements conducting TRL assessments, synthesizing funder-ready impact briefs, and presenting findings to client stakeholders. ○ Manage Impact Measurement Frameworks by updating custom metrics, milestone tracking systems, and annual review structures. ○ Support Capital Raise Advisory
- structuring term sheets, facilitating funder-innovator conversations, and managing deal timelines. ● Thought Leadership & Knowledge Research: ○ Research for thought leadership and knowledge research ○ Contribute to building the practice's proprietary methodologies ○ Research on Indian and global innovation philanthropy landscape ● Data Analysis: ○ Understand the objectives of analytics, the project context, and identify relevant data for achieving objectives ○ Conduct relevant quantitative/qualitative analysis on the data to cull out meaningful insights relevant to client problem ○ Present data insights in a concise and meaningful manner using relevant visualizations ● Stakeholder Engagement ○ Practise active listening in internal as well as external discussions ○ Ensure proactive and regular communication with relevant stakeholders ○ Build credibility with relevant stakeholders through effective and on time delivery ○ Assist in preparing for and coordinating meetings, workshops, and convenings with key partners Key qualifications and experiences At Sattva, our goal is to realize the impact on the ground and to drive a collective win by engaging with multiple stakeholders. This role will provide a high growth opportunity, exposure across all levels of leadership and will be instrumental in driving the next stage of growth. We are looking for passionate individuals who align with our vision and have the following profile:
- 2–4 years of experience in strategic consulting for science and technology-led initiatives, innovation management at research institutes, accelerators, or venture studios
- Project management, and stakeholder engagement experience
- Strong analytical and financial acumen with hands-on experience in data analysis.
- Understanding of innovation and science-based research landscape in India and globally or willingness to learn the innovation aspects
- Client-facing experience in stakeholder management.
- Problem-solver with strong communication and presentation skills, capable of navigating ambiguity and driving outcomes.

jobDescription:
Location : Bangalore/Delhi About Sattva Sattva is a global impact consulting and ecosystem-building firm that works with corporates, social enterprises, non-profits, and governments to drive scalable social impact. We operate at the intersection of data, technology, policy, and implementation to enable equitable and sustainable development. With a presence across India, Singapore, Denmark, and the UK, our work spans over 25 countries. Learn more at www.sattva.co.in . About the Water Data Exchange (WDE) The Water Data Exchange (WDE) is an initiative to create an open digital infrastructure that enables access to credible, granular, and actionable water intelligence. WDE will unlock value across key use cases—such as water numeracy for farmers, risk forecasting for industries, and basin-level collaboration—by integrating diverse data sources and enabling an open infrastructure for the ecosystem to contribute, consume and collaborate on data and water intelligence. The program aims to impact 20 million households over five years on water security, through collaboration with government, corporate, civil society, and research stakeholders. The Opportunity As an Intern, you will support the team on ongoing execution of the overall WDE initiative. You will be a part of cross-functional teams, work closely with governments, companies, civil society organisations, on-ground partners, philanthropic partners and farmers to guide the WDE’s scaling journey from pilot to population-level adoption. This is a unique opportunity to shape a digital public good at the intersection of water sustainability, data, and technology. Key Responsibilities
1. Project Management: Contribute towards project planning and work closely with the project lead in maintaining governance routine to track progress of the project Actively track project timelines and independently own multiple small deliverables or parts of larger deliverable
2. Internal Communications & Writing Produce clear, engaging copy for internal communications and project updates. Help maintain and update the WDE knowledge base Assist in creating and formatting professional slide decks for internal presentations and stakeholder meetings. Use tools like Canva or Power Point to create simple, high-impact visuals that summarize complex information.
3. Event Coordination & Logistics Assist in the end-to-end coordination of workshops and virtual meetings. Manage calendar invites, track RSVPs, and coordinate with external stakeholders when necessary. Act as a point of contact during events to handle technical troubleshooting or administrative needs.
4. Administrative & Organisational Support Assist in organizing digital filing systems and streamlining team processes to improve efficiency. Attend key meetings to record minutes, track action items, and follow up with stakeholders on deadlines. Support senior staff with research, data entry, or specialized administrative tasks as they arise. Ideal Candidate Profile Must-Have: Undergraduate or postgraduate student/graduate in relevant field Ability to write concisely Familiarity with Google Workspace and communication tools (Slack, Teams, or Zoom). Highly organized Why Join Sattva and WDE Be at the forefront of shaping a national public good with potential for global replication. Work with a purpose-driven, interdisciplinary team solving complex societal challenges. Learn, grow, and influence key national missions through data and systems change. Build relationships with the most credible and committed actors across the public, private, and social sectors. We cultivate a supportive and inclusive work environment for all our employees and reinforce diversity in our workplace. All applications regardless of race, religion, caste, color, place of origin, gender, sexuality, disability and age will be welcome and will be fairly evaluated as per the requirements of the role. Please note: The organization follows a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy, under which employees are required to use their personal laptops for work purposes, subject to compliance with the company’s information security and IT policies. Necessary tools for operating, like MS office etc, will be provided. title: Lead- Climate Practice
jobDescription: Location: New Delhi / Gurgaon / Mumbai / Bengaluru (with travel as required) About Sattva We partner to deliver social impact at scale. Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that civil society, business and government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory and orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem, and collaborative solutions and partnerships. Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and the UK, but as a global organisation our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in Climate Practice Sattva’s Climate Practice partners with corporates, philanthropists, foundations, multilaterals, governments and social enterprises to strengthen climate resilience, accelerate decarbonisation and energy transitions, advance circularity and sustainable infrastructure, and champion community-centred climate justice. The practice’s work spans decarbonisation and energy transitions, circularity and material value chains, infrastructure and resilience, heat, water and vertical climate solutions, and climate justice – underpinned by a cross-cutting focus on climate finance. The Opportunity We are looking for a Lead to anchor and grow Sattva’s Climate Practice. This is a senior leadership role for someone with strong conceptual understanding of climate issues and a market-oriented mindset, who can shape the practice’s strategic agenda, deepen institutional expertise across climate domains, build trusted relationships with senior influencers across the climate ecosystem, and enable teams and clients to deliver high-impact climate solutions. Key Responsibilities Climate Leadership & Portfolio Management Join the Climate Practice leadership team, shaping the long-term agenda across decarbonisation, energy transitions, circularity, resilience, climate justice and finance, and supporting the growth of the business across corporate, philanthropic, multilateral and government markets. Provide strategic oversight of the practice’s portfolio of engagements, guiding solution design and delivery – including climate risk assessments, decarbonisation strategies, circularity models, blended finance structures and community-led climate action pathways. Bring deep sector expertise to guide project teams in interpreting climate science, policy frameworks, emissions pathways and resilience strategies, serving as the climate expert in the room for large-scale and complex engagements. Identify emerging themes – such as nature-based solutions, green hydrogen, resilience infrastructure and Scope 3 shifts – and establish benchmarks, frameworks and tools that strengthen Sattva’s climate capability and market positioning. Partnerships & External Representation Build and deepen relationships and relational equity with senior influencers and decision-makers across the climate ecosystem – global and policy bodies (G20, COP processes, UNFCCC-linked organisations and multilaterals such as ADB), philanthropic funders, industry, investors and commercial actors, and NGOs and community-based organisations. Represent Sattva’s work at national and global forums, policy dialogues and working groups, contributing external-facing thought leadership to position Sattva as a credible climate partner. Host and lead sector convenings, roundtables and ecosystem engagements, and support business development by shaping proposals, strengthening technical narratives and identifying market opportunities. Team & Client Management Build, mentor and manage a multidisciplinary climate team across strategy, modelling, policy, science, ecosystem mobilisation and programme delivery. Develop, manage and grow relationships with clients and key stakeholders, advising senior client leaders on climate risk, decarbonisation levers, community resilience, carbon markets and sustainable infrastructure, and taking overall accountability for client success. Ensure strong project management, financial oversight and overall profitability across the practice’s portfolio of engagements. Qualifications and Experience At Sattva, our goal is to realise impact on the ground and drive a collective win by engaging with multiple stakeholders. We are looking for individuals who align with our mission of alleviating poverty in our lifetime and have the following profile: Typically 12–18 years of experience in climate action, sustainability, decarbonisation, climate policy, ESG, adaptation, circularity or related domains, with flexibility for exceptional candidates on either side. Proven expertise in designing or guiding climate programmes across mitigation, adaptation, resilience or circularity. Strong theoretical grounding in climate science or policy combined with a market- and sales-oriented mindset. Experience working with government bodies, multilaterals, corporates, philanthropic funders and NGOs. Ability to translate climate insights into market-relevant, context-specific solutions and to influence senior ecosystem actors. Strong commercial orientation, with the ability to identify opportunities, shape proposals and support sales efforts. Excellent communication, synthesis and stakeholder engagement skills. Self-driven, high-energy and entrepreneurial, with the ability to build and grow a practice area. Why Sattva? It’s not about us really – because IMPACT is everybody’s business. Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design. Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive and collaborative environment. Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow and deliver the best you can. Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow. Sattva is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, caste, creed, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected and/or marginalised characteristics. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing all employees with education, training, and development opportunities to create a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and included. About the Team Sattva’s Innovation Practice is India’s dedicated intermediary for the TRL 4–7 gap, sitting at the intersection of philanthropic capital mobilisation, impact intelligence, and AI-enabled advisory. Underlying everything the Innovation Practice does is a simple conviction: scientific discovery only fulfils its potential when it reaches the people who need it. India produces world-class science. The gap is not in research, it is in the journey from research to real-world application. Two capabilities are needed to bridge that gap, which we are building as a part of Innovation Practice at Sattva: Translational Research Infrastructure – We are increasing our focus on enabling scientists and innovators to prototype, test, and pilot academic research to move faster by enabling this infrastructure. Science Communication
- We are also building our capacity in science communication
- translating complex technology initiatives into stories that a funder, policymaker, or citizen can understand and act on. The Opportunity This is an early stage role in an emerging practice, where Senior Consultant will be one of the founding team members of a practice that is being built from scratch. The ultimate aim of this role would be to inspire and guide the stakeholders to achieve intended outcomes through innovative strategy and implementation efforts. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
At Sattva we believe in outcome-orientation in everything we do. The key responsibilities for this role include:
1. Business Development & Funder Management: -- Own a portfolio of active funder conversations across domestic foundations, international philanthropies, and CSR from proposal and close. -- Lead the preparation of client proposals, Innovation Scan briefs and advisory decks. -- Support in anchoring the roundtable series, the flagship events and other marketing channels. -- Manage follow-through on every warm funder contact ensuring no relationship falls through the cracks.
2. Client Delivery: -- Lead delivery of innovation engagements conducting TRL assessments, synthesizing funder-ready impact briefs, and presenting findings to client stakeholders. -- Build and manage Impact Measurement Frameworks by designing custom metrics, milestone tracking systems, and annual review structures. -- Support Capital Raise Advisory
- structuring term sheets, facilitating funder-innovator conversations, and managing deal timelines.
3. Thought Leadership & Knowledge Research: -- Co-author research papers, policy briefs, and long-form blog content -- Contribute to building the practice's proprietary methodologies -- Monitor the Indian and global innovation philanthropy landscape Key qualifications and experiences: At Sattva, our goal is to realize the impact on the ground and to drive a collective win by engaging with multiple stakeholders. This role will provide a high growth opportunity, exposure across all levels of leadership and will be instrumental in driving the next stage of growth. We are looking for passionate individuals who align with our vision and have the following profile: -- 6-8 years of experience in strategic consulting for science and technology-led initiatives, innovation management at research institutes, accelerators, or venture studios -- Project management, and stakeholder engagement across corporates, consulting firms, social enterprises, or development agencies. -- Strong analytical and financial acumen with hands-on experience in data analysis. -- Solid understanding of innovation and science-based research landscape in India and globally -- Client-facing experience with a proven track record in stakeholder management and delivering strategic advisory. -- Problem-solver with strong communication and presentation skills, capable of navigating ambiguity and driving outcomes. --

PREFERRED

Location: Delhi About Sattva We Partner to deliver social impact at scale We are an organization driven by the mission to end poverty in our lifetime. Our work focuses on scalable solutions for sustainable social impact. We work with our clients
- corporations, philanthropists, foundations, and social organizations
- to achieve social impact goals effectively and maximize the social return on their investment. Deep understanding across sectors and collaboration with multiple stakeholders drive our work. This approach helps us, and our clients develop holistic solutions for solving critical societal problems. We are driven by impact and powered by knowledge. We bring the right balance of the head-heart-hand to our work. Our work is powered by the passionate energy of our mission-driven young team, guided by the strong leadership and advisory board with multi-dimensional experience in business and social sectors. Our team of 400 (and growing rapidly) across offices in Bangalore, Mumbai, and Delhi comes with stellar professional credentials from diverse backgrounds and is bound together by our common commitment to social impact. About the Team Sattva’s Innovation Practice is India’s dedicated intermediary for the TRL 4–7 gap, sitting at the intersection of philanthropic capital mobilisation, impact intelligence, and AI-enabled advisory. Underlying everything the Innovation Practice does is a simple conviction: scientific discovery only fulfils its potential when it reaches the people who need it. India produces world-class science. The gap is not in research, it is in the journey from research to real-world application. Two capabilities are needed to bridge that gap, which we are building as a part of Innovation Practice at Sattva: Translational Research Infrastructure – We are increasing our focus on enabling scientists and innovators to prototype, test, and pilot academic research to move faster by enabling this infrastructure. Science Communication
- We are also building our capacity in science communication
- translating complex technology initiatives into stories that a funder, policymaker, or citizen can understand and act on. The Opportunity This is an early stage role in an emerging practice, where Senior Consultant will be one of the founding team members of a practice that is being built from scratch. The ultimate aim of this role would be to inspire and guide the stakeholders to achieve intended outcomes through innovative strategy and implementation efforts. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
At Sattva we believe in outcome-orientation in everything we do. The key responsibilities for this role include:
1. Business Development & Funder Management: -- Own a portfolio of active funder conversations across domestic foundations, international philanthropies, and CSR from proposal and close. -- Lead the preparation of client proposals, Innovation Scan briefs and advisory decks. -- Support in anchoring the roundtable series, the flagship events and other marketing channels. -- Manage follow-through on every warm funder contact ensuring no relationship falls through the cracks.
2. Client Delivery: -- Lead delivery of innovation engagements conducting TRL assessments, synthesizing funder-ready impact briefs, and presenting findings to client stakeholders. -- Build and manage Impact Measurement Frameworks by designing custom metrics, milestone tracking systems, and annual review structures. -- Support Capital Raise Advisory
- structuring term sheets, facilitating funder-innovator conversations, and managing deal timelines.
3. Thought Leadership & Knowledge Research: -- Co-author research papers, policy briefs, and long-form blog content -- Contribute to building the practice's proprietary methodologies -- Monitor the Indian and global innovation philanthropy landscape Key qualifications and experiences: At Sattva, our goal is to realize the impact on the ground and to drive a collective win by engaging with multiple stakeholders. This role will provide a high growth opportunity, exposure across all levels of leadership and will be instrumental in driving the next stage of growth. We are looking for passionate individuals who align with our vision and have the following profile: -- 6-8 years of experience in strategic consulting for science and technology-led initiatives, innovation management at research institutes, accelerators, or venture studios -- Project management, and stakeholder engagement across corporates, consulting firms, social enterprises, or development agencies. -- Strong analytical and financial acumen with hands-on experience in data analysis. -- Solid understanding of innovation and science-based research landscape in India and globally -- Client-facing experience with a proven track record in stakeholder management and delivering strategic advisory. -- Problem-solver with strong communication and presentation skills, capable of navigating ambiguity and driving outcomes. --
